title: feat(ui): the signed-out invitation landing names the inviter and the organization from the invitation preview
body:
Fixes #26473
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么:** 未登录时打开邀请链接，登录页与注册页会读取服务端的匿名邀请预览(`GET /api/v1/auth/organization/invitation-preview`),卡片标题变为「林晓 邀请你加入 晓林装饰工作室」,并显示打码后的受邀邮箱作为提示。
- **为什么改:** 服务端读取已在 #26020 落地，但没有任何页面调用它;受邀人在注册前看不到是谁、邀请加入哪个组织。
- **风险与回滚:** 低。邮箱是打码值，只作提示，从不预填;预览 404、读取失败或旧服务端都保留现有通用文案，不抛错。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- **先看:** `ui/packages/app-shell/src/console/auth/invitationArrival.tsx` 的 `useInvitationPreview` 与 `invitationArrivalCopy`;`ui/packages/auth/src/createAuthClient.ts` 的 `getInvitationPreview`。
- **两分钟验证:** `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/console/auth/__tests__/invitationPreview-26473.test.tsx packages/auth/src/__tests__/invitationPreview-26473.test.ts`,预期全绿。
- **需要你做的:** 无，席位落地。

## What changes

**`@object-ui/auth`.** `getInvitationPreview(invitationId)` is added to `AuthClient`, `AuthContextValue`, `AuthProvider` and `useAuth()`, along with the exported `AuthInvitationPreview` type (`organizationName`, `inviterName: string | null`, `email`). The client sends one anonymous `GET {authUrl}/organization/invitation-preview?id=ID` with the id URL-encoded. It handles the answers this way:

- 200 with `{ success: true, data }`: the three keys, checked at the boundary.
- 404: `null`. The server sends one uniform not-found for an unknown, expired, accepted, rejected or cancelled id, so this is an answer, not a failure.
- Any other status: a rejection that carries the server's `code` and the HTTP `status`.
- A 200 of the wrong shape: a rejection named `getInvitationPreview`. The page never gets a half-filled sentence.

**`@object-ui/app-shell`.** `invitationArrival.tsx` gains `useInvitationPreview(redirect)` and `invitationArrivalCopy(page, preview, t)`, and both are exported from the package entry.

- The hook reads the id from `?redirect=/accept-invitation/ID`, using the same segment `isInvitationRedirect` tests. It returns the preview for the current id only. It returns `null` while the read is pending, for a 404, and after any failure, including a `useAuth()` double that lacks the method. None of these throws into the page.
- The copy helper returns the title and description for the login or register card. When there is a preview, the title is "INVITER invited you to join ORG", or "You are invited to join ORG" when the inviter has no name, and the description shows the masked address as the one to use. Without a preview it returns the generic copy each page shows today.
- `DefaultLoginPage` and `DefaultRegisterPage` use both for an invitation redirect.

**`@object-ui/console`.** The console's own `/login` and `/register` (`apps/console/src/pages/auth/`) do the same. They are the pages the console routes.

**The masked email.** The preview's `email` is masked by the server (`z***@example.com`). It appears only in the card's description. No field is filled from it, and the pins assert that the email input stays empty.

**`@object-ui/i18n`.** Four keys are added: `auth.login.invitationPreviewTitle`, `auth.login.invitationPreviewTitleNoInviter`, `auth.login.invitationPreviewDescription` and `auth.register.invitationPreviewDescription`.

## Locale packs: all ten, not en and zh only

The dispatch asked for new strings in en and zh only. That was measured, and it reds `ui/packages/i18n/src/__tests__/all-locales-key-parity.test.ts`. That test requires every pack to define every en key, and its only exception is the four outbound AI-message keys. The run under the lock with en and zh only: `Tests 8 failed | 40 passed (48)`, one failure per other locale, for example `ar is missing 4 key(s): auth.login.invitationPreviewDescription, auth.login.invitationPreviewTitle, auth.login.invitationPreviewTitleNoInviter, auth.register.invitationPreviewDescription`. So the four keys are added to ar, de, es, fr, ja, ko, pt and ru as well, each on its own new lines next to the existing invitation keys.

- No existing value is changed.
- The en pack's comment above the invitation keys is updated, because it said the copy names no organization.
- Seat 1's #26469 also edits these packs. A conflict there would be one of line placement only.

## Tests (red first)

New files:

- `ui/packages/auth/src/__tests__/invitationPreview-26473.test.ts` (5 tests). Cases: found (exact keys, one GET, encoded id); found with a null inviter; 404 resolves `null`; 429 rejects with `code` and `status`; a wrong-shape 200 rejects.
- `ui/packages/app-shell/src/console/auth/__tests__/invitationPreview-26473.test.tsx` covers `DefaultLoginPage` and `DefaultRegisterPage`, rendered through a real `AuthProvider`, a real `createAuthClient` and a real `I18nProvider`, with only `fetch` stubbed. Cases:
  - found: inviter and organization in the heading, the masked address shown, the email field empty;
  - found without an inviter;
  - 404: generic copy;
  - failed reads (500, a network failure, a wrong-shape body): generic copy, and the form still renders;
  - a login that did not come from an invitation sends no preview request.
- `ui/apps/console/src/pages/auth/__tests__/invitationPreview-26473.test.tsx` runs found, 404 and 500 on the console's `/login` and `/register`.

The red leg was run under the lock: the 14 implementation files were restored to the base `00a4593a` in the working tree only, the new files were run, and then the files were restored to `HEAD`. The restore was proved by hash comparison and an empty `git diff HEAD`.

Red, with the implementation at base:

- auth file: 5 of 5 tests fail (`client.getInvitationPreview is not a function`).
- app-shell file: 9 of 10 fail. The one that passes is the preservation pin (no preview request without an invitation redirect), which is expected to pass at base.
- console file: 6 of 6 fail.

Green at head: see Verification.

## Acceptance notes

- `invitationIdOf` in `invitationArrival.tsx` reads the same `/accept-invitation/` segment as `isInvitationRedirect` in `signUpOffer.ts`. That file is in open PR #26483 and was not touched here. Once #26483 lands, `isInvitationRedirect` could be expressed as `invitationIdOf(r) !== null`, leaving one parser.
- The card also suggests a warning when the typed address does not match the masked pattern. The seat's route did not include it, so it is not done here. The masked address is shown, and the server still refuses a non-invitee's sign-up.
- The card's optional "greet from ObjectOS Cloud" on the environment host is not taken. It is a matter of taste and outside the seat's route.
- `AcceptInvitationPage` is unchanged. A signed-out visitor is redirected from it to `/login` before it renders, and a signed-in visitor already gets the organization through `get-invitation`.
- The claim's file surface named `invitationArrival.tsx`, `AcceptInvitationPage.tsx`, the console sign-up page, `createAuthClient.ts` and the locale packs. This diff also touches four files the card itself lists (both `LoginPage.tsx` files and both `RegisterPage.tsx` files), the auth package's `types.ts`, `AuthContext.ts`, `AuthProvider.tsx`, `useAuth.ts` and `index.ts` (needed to reach the read from a page), the app-shell `index.ts` export, and all ten locale packs.

## Verification

All runs are on head `b848d2b1`, in a worktree based on `origin/main` `00a4593a`. Heavy runs went through `scripts/pm/os-verify-lock.sh`.

- Closure: `pnpm --workspace-concurrency=2 --filter '@object-ui/console^...' build` gave `VERDICT command-exit 0`.
- `vitest run` (from `ui/`) over `packages/auth/`, `packages/i18n/` and the 13 app-shell test files that import the touched pages (the new file included): `Test Files 136 passed (136)`, `Tests 1781 passed | 13 skipped (1794)`.
- Console project, over the 21 console test files that import the two console pages (the new file included): `Test Files 21 passed (21)`, `Tests 110 passed (110)`.
- `pnpm --filter X run type-check` exited 0 for each of `@object-ui/auth`, `@object-ui/i18n`, `@object-ui/app-shell` and `@object-ui/console`.
- ui i18n gates `check:i18n-keys` (it checks every inline `defaultValue` against the en pack), `check:i18n-drift` and `check:i18n-dead-keys`: exit 0.
- `node scripts/check-sdui-manifest.mjs`: exit 0. No registry component contract changed, so the manifest is not regenerated.
- Derived gates (`dispatch-gates.mjs --commands`): 34 commands. 32 exited 0. Two were not measured, and CI runs both:
  - `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run scripts/` exited 99, a lock queue-timeout, three times.
  - `pnpm check:type-check-debt` exited 3, PREREQUISITE NOT MET, because its re-measure build never got a lock turn. The four touched packages' own type-checks are green above.

  The `--ran` reconciliation reads 34 accounted, 33 run, 1 NOT-MEASURED. The tool classifies exit 3 only, so the exit-99 vitest run counts as NOT MEASURED here as well.
- `pnpm check:changeset-fixed` and `pnpm check:nul-bytes`: exit 0.
